classification.difficultyReason: Determine a linear branch from two graph points and express the complete V-shaped graph using absolute value.

content.prompt: These diagrams show the graph of absolute value functions in the form $f(x)=|ax+b|$. Find the equation of each one by finding the equation of a linear “branch” of the graph.

spec.description: Upward V at the origin, arrowheads on both branches, no grid, and dashed guides to (1,2).
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph only; equation belongs in answers.

answer.worked:
Use the right branch through $(0,0)$ and $(1,2)$.
$$\begin{align*}a&=\frac{2-0}{1-0}\\a&=2\\b&=0\end{align*}$$
The branch is $y=2x$, so $f(x)=|2x|$.

spec.description: Upward V with vertex (1,0), y-intercept 1, arrowheads on both branches and no grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph only; equation belongs in answers.

answer.worked:
Use the left branch through $(0,1)$ and $(1,0)$.
$$\begin{align*}a&=\frac{0-1}{1-0}\\a&=-1\\b&=1\end{align*}$$
The branch is $y=-x+1$, so $f(x)=|-x+1|=|x-1|$.

spec.description: Upward V with vertex (-2,0), y-intercept 4, arrowheads on both branches and no grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph only; equation belongs in answers.

answer.worked:
Use the right branch through $(-2,0)$ and $(0,4)$.
$$\begin{align*}a&=\frac{4-0}{0-(-2)}\\a&=2\\b&=4\end{align*}$$
The branch is $y=2x+4$, so $f(x)=|2x+4|$.

spec.description: Upward V with vertex (1/3,0), stacked fractional vertex label, y-intercept 1, arrowheads on both branches and no grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph only; equation belongs in answers.

answer.worked:
Use the left branch through $(0,1)$ and $(\frac13,0)$.
$$\begin{align*}a&=\frac{0-1}{\frac13-0}\\a&=-3\\b&=1\end{align*}$$
The branch is $y=-3x+1$, so $f(x)=|-3x+1|=|3x-1|$.
